title: 10kW Hybrid Inverter + 20kWh Battery Reference in Israel
summary: A 10kW hybrid inverter with 20kWh of battery storage in Israel.
challenge: Small hybrid systems are settled by backup-load selection. Which circuits stay live, and for how long, sets the battery size far more than total household consumption does.
solution: A 10kW hybrid inverter and a 20kWh battery bank, sized from the backed-up circuits rather than from the whole-house figure.
